+## Abstract
+
+Finite-difference propagation under local codes.
+
+**Theorem 1.1 (Finite-window codes preserve finite disagreement).**

+Lean statement: `D5/S1/Dynamics/Symbolic/PermutativeLifts/FiniteDifferencePropagation.finite_difference_code`

+variable {A : Type*} {k : ℕ}
+variable {h : (Fin (k + 2) → A) → A}
+
+/-!
+An output disagreement at `i` can only be caused by an input disagreement in
+the length-`k+2` window beginning at `i`.  Thus the output disagreement set is
+contained in a finite union of integer translates of the input disagreement
+set.
+-/
+theorem finite_difference_code {x y : ℤ → A} (hfin : FiniteDifference x y) :
+    FiniteDifference (code h x) (code h y) := by
+  let D : Set ℤ := {i : ℤ | x i ≠ y i}
+  let E : Set ℤ := {i : ℤ | code h x i ≠ code h y i}
+  have hD : D.Finite := hfin
+  have hsubset : E ⊆ ⋃ j : Fin (k + 2), (fun d : ℤ => d - (j : ℕ)) '' D := by
+    intro i hi
+    by_contra hnot
+    have hall : ∀ j : Fin (k + 2), x (i + (j : ℕ)) = y (i + (j : ℕ)) := by
+      intro j
+      by_contra hne
+      apply hnot
+      refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, ?_⟩
+      refine ⟨i + (j : ℕ), ?_, ?_⟩
+      · exact hne
+      · push_cast
+        omega
+    apply hi
+    change h (window x i) = h (window y i)
+    congr 1
+    funext j
+    exact hall j
+  have hfinite : (⋃ j : Fin (k + 2), (fun d : ℤ => d - (j : ℕ)) '' D).Finite := by
+    exact Set.finite_iUnion (fun j => hD.image _)
+  exact hfinite.subset hsubset
+
+/-- The `n`-fold iterate of a fixed finite-window code. -/
+def codeIter (h : (Fin (k + 2) → A) → A) : ℕ → (ℤ → A) → (ℤ → A)
+  | 0, x => x
+  | n + 1, x => code h (codeIter h n x)
+
+/-!
+Finite disagreement is preserved at every finite iterate.  The induction is
+the reusable bridge for later homoclinic-class and code-composition arguments.
+-/
+theorem finite_difference_code_iterate (n : ℕ) {x y : ℤ → A}
+    (hfin : FiniteDifference x y) :
+    FiniteDifference (codeIter h n x) (codeIter h n y) := by
+  induction n with
+  | zero => exact hfin
+  | succ n ih =>
+      simpa [codeIter] using (finite_difference_code (h := h) ih)
+
+end D5.S1.Dynamics.Symbolic.PermutativeLifts.FiniteDifferencePropagation

+
+$$
+B=A P^{\otimes k},\qquad k\ge1,
+\tag{30.1}
+$$
+
+具有原 X 的含幺 Jordan/D 嵌入。它不要求这个 $A$ 有一个直接声明的 $AP$。在这个 $B$ 内有同一整个原 $P$ 的嵌入 $j$，以及每个原准备 $\gamma$ 对应的实际乘积准备 $\eta_\gamma$，满足
+
+$$
+\eta_\gamma\bigl(\iota_A(a)\circ j(d)\bigr)=\gamma(a)
+\qquad(a\in E_A).
+\tag{30.2}
+$$
+
+**证明。** 身份算子属于每个指定 $(G_A)_{u_A}$。假设 2.1 的逐点量词给实际原事件 $f_{\operatorname{Id},A}:A\to A$，响应为身份，连同它的完整装置、原零响应补记录及所有输出。假设 2.5 经定义 10.2 替换后，对这个事件同样提供任意大的实际 $f_{\operatorname{Id},A}\mid P^{\otimes k}$，输入输出是 (30.1)。这里只取一份存在的正整数 $k$；不从“任意大”推断每个特定 $k$ 都可用。定义 10.2 保留的 X 条件适用于这些原参考联合对象，它们自己也在 P/G/I/II 的所需对象范围中。
+
+原幂、结合和含幺接口给嵌入 $j_k:E_P\to E_{P^{\otimes k}}$，把一个因子放入第一个位置，其余放原单位；它逐次保持 Jordan 乘法和原 $D$。取 $j=\iota_{P^{\otimes k}}j_k$。这是已有幂及 (30.1) 内的局部嵌入，不把其中的子空间重新对象化，也不新增中间复合。
+
+由原测试 $0\le d\le u_P$、准备次归一及 $\alpha(d)=1$，直接有 $\alpha(u_P)=1$。原 X 的乘积准备供应给出同一 $\alpha$ 的实际 $k$ 重乘积 $\alpha_k$，再给每个原 $\gamma$ 一个实际 $\eta_\gamma=\gamma\otimes\alpha_k$。其原评价为

+$$
+\alpha_k(j_k(d))=\alpha(d)\alpha(u_P)^{k-1}=1,
+\qquad
+\eta_\gamma(\iota_A(a)\circ j(d))=\gamma(a).
+$$
+

+&\operatorname{Law}_z\bigl(\eta,[\bar z]_{K_n},r\bigr)
